title: Build artifact provenance, SBOM and dependency integrity
workflow: Resolve trusted source revision and immutable dependencies
Build reproducibly in isolated runner with limited secrets
Generate SBOM and artifact digest from actual build bytes
Run supported vulnerability, license and integrity checks
Quarantine issues requiring review and record exceptions
Sign and promote exact artifact digest after approval
invariants: Do not invent vulnerability scan passes or attestation signatures
Dependence on a package registry is subject to reproducibility and availability plan
Only digest-pinned candidate artifacts may enter controlled stages
Secrets must not be embedded in container layers or build logs
Critical financial service images require additional integrity acceptance
Past release artifacts remain retrievable for incident reconstruction
planned_tests: Scanner failure status remains NOT_RUN/FAILED rather than PASS
Signed release maps to exact Git SHA
approval_gate: Approved dependency policy, trusted build environment and actual reproducibility/security test outputs.
